mathematical_definition: max(cusum_pos, -cusum_neg) / clip(threshold, 1e-9, None), a two-sided CUSUM in price space over close-to-close differences: threshold = clip(cusum_k * fillna(ewma_vol, median(ewma_vol)) * close, 1e-6, None); cusum_pos/cusum_neg accumulate signed close diffs and both reset to 0 whenever either breaches +/-threshold. cusum_k is an explicit function parameter (production value 2.5, per learning/train.py's CUSUM_K -- moved out of an in-function `from learning.train import CUSUM_K` import to keep features/ free of learning/ imports, test_boundary.py)
numerical_stability_notes: Computed via a plain sequential Python for-loop (not numba-jitted, unlike family A's run_length_signed) -- O(n) single pass but with Python-level per-bar overhead
missing_value_policy: 0.0 at bar 0 (cusum_pos/cusum_neg both start at 0.0); never NaN thereafter since threshold is clipped away from 0
status_reason: Not a v3 survivor (research/output/v3_feature_survivors.json): catboost_importance=0.001 (<0.3), MI rank 58 (outside top 15). catboost_importance=0.001, mi_rank=58, family=C_jump_change. Kept registered per spec section 9 -- Phase 4 may find it useful for a different target.
